Release Notes — Widget Suite 2.4

Published 2024-08-15 · Build 2.4.0-184

Important: this release changes the on-disk format of configuration files. Backup existing configurations before upgrading.

AreaWhat changedDocs
DashboardNew capacity view with trend linesWK-1101

Bug fixes

Fixed a race in the scheduler that could stall nightly reports on multi-core hosts (WK-1094). Fixed an off-by-one in the pager that hid the last row of long lists (WK-1098).

All styling for this document comes from the linked stylesheet style-05.css — there is no inline style block.
